stories.title: Une enquête ouverte pour "apologie du terrorisme" dans le Loiret après la diffusion d'une vidéo montrant "des lycéens" chanter une chanson mentionnant "Mohamed Merah"

en.title: Investigation opened for "apology of terrorism" in Loiret after video showing "high school students" singing song mentioning "Mohamed Merah"
en.summary: Authorities in Loiret opened an investigation after a rap song evoking terrorists Mohamed Merah and Salah Abdeslam was circulated, allegedly featuring high school students. The Orleans prosecutor also opened an inquiry into the communications service that distributed the material.

stories.title: Mobilisation des lycéens : 450 000 manifestants au niveau national, annonce l'intersyndicale de la jeunesse, 256 000 selon le ministère de l'Intérieur

en.title: High school student mobilization: 450,000 protesters nationwide, announced by youth union federation, 256,000 according to Interior Ministry
en.summary: Tens of thousands of high school students protested throughout the day, joined by union members, teachers, and university students. Estimates of total participants ranged from 256,000 according to the Interior Ministry to 450,000 according to youth organizations.

stories.title: A Metz, la jeune fille touchée à la poitrine par un policier aurait «réfuté» toute agression sexuelle, selon le parquet

en.title: In Metz, young girl touched on chest by police officer allegedly "denied" any sexual assault, according to prosecutors
en.summary: A viral video showed a man's hand making contact with a young girl's hair and chest while she was restrained on the ground. However, the Metz prosecutor stated the girl denied experiencing any violent or sexual assault.

stories.title: Lycéen blessé à Saint-Ouen-l’Aumône : le policier ayant tiré au lance-grenade mis en examen

en.title: High school student injured in Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône: police officer who fired tear gas launcher placed under examination
en.summary: A 14-year-old named Eden suffered severe facial injuries last week during high school student protests. The officer responsible was placed under judicial supervision, charged with violence causing permanent mutilation or disability, and suspended from duty pending further notice.

stories.title: Mobilisation lycéenne : le policier auteur du tir d’une grenade lacrymogène dans le visage d’un élève a été mis en examen

en.title: Student mobilisation: police officer who fired tear gas grenade at student's face placed under examination
en.summary: A police officer has been placed under judicial investigation following an incident on September 28 in Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône where a tear gas grenade was fired at a student during youth protests.

stories.title: Rachat de Warner Bros par Paramount : la fusion finalisée, le nouveau groupe renommé «Skydance»

en.title: Warner Bros acquisition by Paramount: merger finalized, new group renamed "Skydance"
en.summary: Paramount has completed its acquisition of Warner Bros for 110 billion dollars, creating a combined entity that includes Warner Bros studios, HBO Max streaming service, and television channels including CNN and Discovery.

stories.title: En Allemagne, l’AfD accède à la présidence d’un Parlement régional, une première depuis 1945

en.title: In Germany, AfD reaches presidency of a regional Parliament, a first since 1945
en.summary: In the first round of voting, 48 deputies voted for the far-right party in a regional parliament presidency, following its overwhelming electoral victory in Saxe-Anhalt against Friedrich Merz's conservatives.

stories.title: Paramount finalise l'acquisition de Warner Bros Discovery, créant un nouveau géant du cinéma et de la télévision, renommé Skydance

en.title: Paramount finalizes acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, creating new entertainment giant renamed Skydance
en.summary: Paramount has completed its acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, forming a major cinema and television conglomerate, though some in the industry worry the merger could result in job losses.

stories.title: 🔴 Colère lycéenne en direct : 450 000 manifestants en France selon les organisateurs, 256 000 selon l'Intérieur

en.title: High school student anger in real time: 450,000 protesters in France according to organizers, 256,000 according to Interior Ministry
en.summary: High school students protested in France with organizers reporting 450,000 participants while government officials counted 256,000 attendees.

stories.title: Dans le Val-d'Oise, le policier soupçonné d'avoir blessé un adolescent au visage a été mis en examen et placé sous contrôle judiciaire

en.title: In Val-d'Oise, the police officer suspected of wounding a teenager in the face was examined and placed under judicial supervision
en.summary: A police officer in Val-d'Oise faces legal proceedings after a 14-year-old was injured by a grenade during a high school protest blockade.

stories.title: L’extrême droite allemande décroche la présidence d’un Parlement régional, une première depuis 1945

en.title: German far-right party wins presidency of regional parliament, a first since 1945
en.summary: A far-right party gained the regional parliament presidency with Tobias Rausch elected by four more votes than anticipated, suggesting defections from conservative ranks.

stories.title: Mobilisation des lycéens : Sébastien Lecornu annonce une suspension des cours en fin de semaine pour «un temps de démocratie interne»

en.title: Mobilization of high school students: Sébastien Lecornu announces suspension of classes at end of week for "a time of internal democracy"
en.summary: The government leader announced classes would be suspended at week's end during high school protests and called for political unity with public servants affected by violence.

stories.title: Financement participatif immobilier : Bricks s’offre un agrément bancaire en rachetant Izola Bank

en.title: Real estate crowdfunding: Bricks acquires banking license by purchasing Izola Bank
en.summary: French fintech Bricks, which specializes in real estate crowdfunding, is acquiring Malta-based digital bank Izola Bank. The transaction requires approval from the European Central Bank and Maltese financial authorities.

stories.title: Quand Air France-KLM fait valoir son poids dans l’économie française et européenne

en.title: When Air France-KLM asserts its weight in the French and European economy
en.summary: Air France-KLM generates over 52 billion euros in economic impact in France, representing 1.8 percent of GDP. The airline highlights this figure to demonstrate its value creation across the country to political leaders and the public.

stories.title: Schneider Electric : une dette record qui inquiète les marchés, mais un tournant stratégique vers la data

en.title: Schneider Electric: record debt concerning markets, but a strategic pivot toward data
en.summary: Schneider Electric is pursuing acquisitions of Cognite and PTC to shift toward industrial and energy data services across product lifecycle stages. The company faces investor concerns as its debt has recently doubled.

stories.title: Mobilisation des lycéens : 450 000 personnes ont défilé selon les organisateurs, 256 000, selon le ministère de l’Intérieur

en.title: Student mobilization: 450,000 people marched according to organizers, 256,000 according to Interior Ministry
en.summary: French Interior Ministry counted approximately 256,000 protesters on Tuesday, including 56,000 in Paris, while demonstration organizers reported 450,000 participants nationwide, with 100,000 in Paris.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : les crédits pour les énergies renouvelables et le nucléaire divisent les députés

en.title: 2027 Budget: Credits for renewable energy and nuclear power divide lawmakers
en.summary: France's 2027 budget proposal includes nuclear financing through savings, a refocus of the green fund, and reduced support for renewable energy and heating funds. These measures face criticism from opposition groups across the political spectrum.
